testcase.name: cleanPages preserves genuine chapter headings and subheadings
cleanPages reassembles chapter prefix and title across lines into unified heading
legacy page labels are silent without shifting offsets
cleanPages preserves subheading followed by dialogue quote as separate blocks
cleanPages preserves table of contents items on distinct lines
cleanPages does not turn book text with wide spacing or tabs into pipe tables
page metadata never becomes spoken prose
cleanPages recognizes isolated topic headings like Plot Synopsis and Conflict
cleanPages does not break regular sentences with spacing after period
cleanPages recognizes isolated uppercase headings but excludes shouting dialogue
cleanPages preserves bullet list items on separate lines
cleanPages does not chop sentences starting with Part into headings
cleanPages preserves existing markdown pipe tables
cleanPages does not treat continuous words in paragraph as headings
